senses.gloss:
r. 1st cl. (रोचति)
1 To shine.
2 To please, to be pleased.

f. (रुक्)
1 Light, lustre, splendour.
2 Beauty, loveliness.
3 Lightning.
4 Wish, desire.
5 The chattering of the parrot or Maina.
6 The Ṛg Veda.
E.
रुच् to shine, aff. क्विप्; also with टाप् added रुचा.

mfn. (-कः-का-कं)
1 Agreeable, pleasing.
2 Sharp, acrid.
3 Tonic, stomachic.
m. (-कः)
1 The citron, (Citrus medica.)
2 An ornament of the neck or breast.
3 A tooth.
4 A pigeon.
n. (-कं)
1 Salt.
2 Natron, alkali.
3 Borax.
4 A garland, a chaplet.
5 A curl on a horse's neck.
6 The woody Cassia.
7 Any auspicious or fortunate object.
8 A perfume, commonly Rocanā.
9 An anthelmintic medicine, commonly Virenga, (Embelia ribes?)
10 A sort of temple.
11 A stomachic.
E.
रुच to shine, &c. in the causal form, क्वुन् aff.; the embellisher, the polisher, &c.

f. (-चिः-ची)
1 Light, lustre.
2 Beauty.
3 Passion.
4 Wish, desire.
5 A ray of light.
6 Intent application to any object or undertaking.
7 Hunger, appetite.
8 Taste, sentiment.
E.
रुच् to shine, कि aff.

mfn. (-रः-रा-रं)
1 Beautifying.
2 Sharpening, as the appetite, &c.
E.
रुचि, and कर what makes.

mfn. (-तः-ता-तं)
1 Sweet.
2 Sharpened, (as the appetite.)
3 Digested.
4 Bright, brightened.
f. (-ता)
Species of the Atijagatī metre.
E.
रुच to please, Uṇādi aff. कितच्.

mfn. (-रः-रा-रं)
1 Beautiful, charming, pleasing.
2 Sweet.
3 Stomachic, restorative.
E.
रुच to please, Uṇādi aff. किरच्.

mfn. (-द्)
Exquisite, affording great pleasure.
E.
रुचिर, and मुद what delights.

mfn. (-नः-ना-नं)
Handsome, beautiful.
E.
रुचिर, and आनन face.

f. (-ङ्गी)
A beautiful charming woman.
E.
रुचिर, and अपाङ्ग corner of the eye.

mfn. (-ष्यः-ष्या-ष्यं)
1 Sweet.
2 Stomachic.
E.
रुच to be agreeable, Uṇādi aff. किष्यन्.

mfn. (-च्यः-च्या-च्यं)
1 Beautiful, pleasing.
2 Stomachic, tonic.
m. (-च्यः)
A husband, a lover.
n. (-च्यं)
A digestive, a tonic.
E.
रुच to please, aff. क्यप्.
